title: Register each Illinois salon or shop with IDFPR
authority: Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation
description: Each Illinois business providing barbering, cosmetology, esthetics, hair braiding or nail technology services must obtain a separate salon or shop certificate of registration for each location before operating. The requirement also covers mobile, kiosk, rented-space and contracted service locations; individual service providers must hold the applicable professional license.
renewal: Maintain a current registration and complete the required annual salon/shop self-inspection; a separate registration is required for each location.
